verdict.rationale: LiteLLM documents one `completion()` interface for every provider, with responses always in OpenAI Chat Completions format, and a maintainer confirmed the proxy supports function calling the same way as the openai-python SDK. Together these imply a consistent tool-calling schema across providers. Missing for 10: first-party docs specific to tool/function-call translation across providers, evidence of which providers support tool calls, and independent hands-on corroboration of cross-provider tool-call consistency.
